target.statement: Average GitHub stars gained within 24 hours of Hacker News exposure (Δ24h stars = 121.1)

compute.basis: Requires re-collecting data via HN Algolia and GitHub REST APIs (rate-limited, ~138 repos × 14 days of hourly star counts), then running event study aggregation; paper claims <5 min runtime but data collection dominates and may hit API limits.

blockers: GitHub API rate limits (60 req/hr unauthenticated, 5000/hr authenticated) may slow or block full data collection
Paper does not provide cached data or exact search queries/parameters, so reproduction depends on re-running API calls
Some repositories may have disabled stargazer access, requiring fallback to metadata-only analysis
title: Launch-Day Diffusion: Tracking Hacker News Impact on GitHub Stars for AI Tools
